diff --git a/test/units/plugins/filter/test_mathstuff.py b/test/units/plugins/filter/test_mathstuff.py
index a0e78d3..45c8ee2 100644
--- a/test/units/plugins/filter/test_mathstuff.py
+++ b/test/units/plugins/filter/test_mathstuff.py
@@ -64,16 +64,57 @@ class TestSymmetricDifference:
 
 class TestMin:
     def test_min(self):
-        assert ms.min((1, 2)) == 1
-        assert ms.min((2, 1)) == 1
-        assert ms.min(('p', 'a', 'w', 'b', 'p')) == 'a'
+        assert ms.min(env, (1, 2)) == 1
+        assert ms.min(env, (2, 1)) == 1
+        assert ms.min(env, ('p', 'a', 'w', 'b', 'p')) == 'a'
 
 
 class TestMax:
     def test_max(self):
-        assert ms.max((1, 2)) == 2
-        assert ms.max((2, 1)) == 2
-        assert ms.max(('p', 'a', 'w', 'b', 'p')) == 'w'
+        assert ms.max(env, (1, 2)) == 2
+        assert ms.max(env, (2, 1)) == 2
+        assert ms.max(env, ('p', 'a', 'w', 'b', 'p')) == 'w'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name', ('min', 'max'))
+def test_min_max_attribute_and_case_sensitive(name):
+    if getattr(ms, 'do_' + name) is None:
+        pytest.skip('Jinja2 does not provide do_%s' % name)
+    filters = ms.FilterModule().filters()
+    template_env = Environment()
+    template_env.filters.update(filters)
+    values = [{'size': 2, 'name': 'a'}, {'size': 1, 'name': 'B'}]
+    expected = values[1] if name == 'min' else values[0]
+    assert template_env.from_string('{{ values | %s(attribute="size") }}' % name).render(values=values) == str(expected)
+    names = ['a', 'B']
+    expected_name = 'B' if name == 'min' else 'a'
+    assert template_env.from_string('{{ values | %s(case_sensitive=True) }}' % name).render(values=names) == expected_name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name', ('min', 'max'))
+def test_min_max_forwards_all_keywords(monkeypatch, name):
+    received = {}
+
+    def jinja_filter(environment, values, **kwargs):
+        received.update({'environment': environment, 'values': values, 'kwargs': kwargs})
+        return 'result'
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, 'do_' + name, jinja_filter)
+    values = [1, 2]
+    assert getattr(ms, name)(env, values, attribute='size', case_sensitive=True, extra='value') == 'result'
+    assert received == {'environment': env, 'values': values,
+                        'kwargs': {'attribute': 'size', 'case_sensitive': True, 'extra': 'value'}}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name', ('min', 'max'))
+def test_min_max_without_jinja_filter(monkeypatch, name):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, 'do_' + name, None)
+    function = getattr(ms, name)
+    assert function(env, [2, 1]) == (1 if name == 'min' else 2)
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as exc:
+        function(env, [2, 1], case_sensitive=False)
+    assert exc.value.message == ("Ansible's %s filter does not support any keyword arguments. "
+                                 "You need Jinja2 2.10 or later that provides their version of the filter." % name)
